claim.operational_target: Replay-verify an exact declared set of local official Tyler source snapshots, combine every post without cross-page replay, and assign immutable temporal evidence roles.
claim.interpretation: Passing supports supplied-snapshot completeness and deterministic temporal separation only.
alternatives: archive pages overlap because pagination moved during collection
the collector omitted pages outside the declared input set
renamed or duplicated posts inflate the sample
semantic paraphrases evade exact duplicate detection
claim.refusal_state: Refuse unreplayable evidence, planned-input mismatch, cross-source replay, temporal leakage, future unregistered evidence, old schema, or tampering.
claim.scope: Local official Marginal Revolution Tyler Cowen author-archive or RSS snapshots published through 2026-07-31.

identifiability.distinguishing_evidence: Raw-snapshot replay distinguishes a reproducible supplied corpus from a derived JSON summary; exact expected URL binding distinguishes planned-input completeness from silent omission within the plan.
unidentified_questions: whether the declared page list covers the full archive
whether the publisher omitted or changed historical posts
whether two different texts are semantic duplicates
whether public prose reflects a private decision rule

evidence.completeness_boundary: Software proves that every declared URL has one replayable snapshot. An external append-only registry is required to prove the declared list was fixed and archive-complete.

computation.deployment_kernel: One corpus verification and temporal-role kernel is used at creation, loading, CLI output, and downstream verification.
computation.selection_kernel: All posts from all declared verified sources are retained; there is no semantic selection.
computation.uncertainty_scope: No statistical or psychological uncertainty is estimated; missing archive coverage and semantic duplication remain unquantified.

results.summary: 229/229 full PCFM regression tests passed in 196.573 seconds

remaining_limitations: Only the existing 2026-07-31 RSS snapshot is present; historical author-archive pages have not yet been acquired.
No real human annotations have been collected.
Exact matching cannot detect semantic duplicates.
Local files cannot prove external archive completeness.
The multi-source corpus is not yet integrated with a lineage-bound multi-source dual-annotation packet schema.
